name: FRep R-function Boolean Operations
definition: A method to perform set-theoretic operations (union, intersection, subtraction) on implicit surfaces defined by scalar fields f1 and f2 using R-functions, ensuring continuity properties based on the parameter alpha.
summary: FRep R-function Boolean Operations perform set-theoretic operations on implicit surfaces using R-functions to ensure specific continuity properties, unlike standard SDF operations which produce discontinuities.
